prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page composition option, approximately 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Create composition option B for the already selected clean category-standard Aljohn Polyglot coaching visual world. Keep the exact navy/red/white identity, premium editorial craft, typography character, and quiet component language of Image 1, but do not copy its split-hero composition. Use a proof-first topology with fluid responsive proportions.
Input images: Image 1 is the selected visual-direction reference and contributes only palette, type character, spacing quality, and component finish—not its layout. Image 2 is Aljohn Polyglot’s identity-preserving portrait. Image 3 is L.A. Sarmiento’s identity-preserving proof-video portrait.
Structure: quiet shared global navbar; below it a fluid 38/62 hero split. Left rail: exact headline “From Theory to Real-World Fluency”, “Personalized Language Coaching”, concise offer copy, price “500 PHP / 30 minutes”, “Google Meet”, and a prominent red “Book a Session” action. Right dominant region: a large playable proof-video frame using L.A.’s outdoor portrait and exact title “L.A. Sarmiento’s 7-Month Transformation”; a slim seven-month progress strip is integrated immediately beneath the video. Aljohn’s portrait appears as a smaller authoritative coach portrait bridging the left offer and right proof rather than owning half the viewport. A narrow lower band shows three concise benefits without equal-card repetition. The result must clearly be a real persuasive website and show enough second fold to prove continuation.
Style/medium: realistic shippable product UI screenshot, clean editorial grid, conventional coaching category executed impeccably.
Color palette: white, deep navy #102a56, red #d13b35, warm yellow #f4c430, dark readable text.
Materials: clean flat surfaces, portrait photography, quiet dividers, restrained shadow.
Text (verbatim where shown): “Aljohn Polyglot”; “Coaching”; “From Theory to Real-World Fluency”; “Personalized Language Coaching”; “Book a Session”; “500 PHP / 30 minutes”; “Google Meet”; “L.A. Sarmiento’s 7-Month Transformation”.
Constraints: preserve both portrait identities; practical desktop layout; fluid 38/62 ratio, not fixed pixel boxes; visible primary action; proof earns the promise; high contrast; no invented claims or metrics.
Avoid: reproducing Image 1’s half-and-half portrait hero, generic AI gradients, excess rounded cards, glassmorphism, fake nav labels, fake testimonials, logos, watermark, browser chrome, device mockup, illegible microtext, fixed pixel annotations.
